[LSER.15.2] When an (aggregation, time-model) combination has no exact backing
([LSER.18]), the compiler **must** refuse the declaration with
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING`. The percentiles (`pXX` / `median`) need
a **bounded** window for an exact quantile — the raw-sample ring buffer over a
`sliding` window, or a `sample <n>` reservoir — so their `all_time` and
`tumbling` forms are refused. Cardinality, per-value frequency and membership
are exact on a bounded `sliding` window only, so their `all_time` and
`tumbling` forms are refused too. The diagnostic **should** name the refused
combination and the bounded forms that would satisfy it.
